scripts.dev:api: corepack pnpm --dir apps/api exec ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only src/main.ts
scripts.build:api: corepack pnpm --dir apps/api exec nest build
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run build:api && corepack pnpm run build:admin && corepack pnpm run build:user
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm run lint:api && corepack pnpm run lint:admin && corepack pnpm run lint:user
scripts.typecheck:api: corepack pnpm --dir apps/api exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run typecheck:api && corepack pnpm run typecheck:admin && corepack pnpm run typecheck:user
scripts.test:e2e:api: corepack pnpm --dir apps/api exec jest --config jest-e2e.json --runInBand
scripts.db:migrate: corepack pnpm exec prisma migrate dev --schema=database/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:deploy: corepack pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy --schema=database/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:status: corepack pnpm exec prisma migrate status --schema=database/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.verify:phase1: corepack pnpm run db:validate && corepack pnpm run lint:api && corepack pnpm run typecheck:api && corepack pnpm run test:api && corepack pnpm run test:e2e:api && corepack pnpm run build:api
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm run db:validate && corepack pnpm run lint && corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm run test:api && corepack pnpm run test:e2e:api && corepack pnpm run build
